_comment: Routine action kind `webWatch` (mchatai_macOS/docs/ROUTINES_ARCHITECTURE.md §3.3, §7). During the transition the watch's own payload stays in C/AIWebJobs/jobs.json; the routine points at it by id and replaces AIWebJobTrigger's separate 60-second ticker. A watch that is already running is skipped: alreadyRunning (with a row, not a silent log line).
summary: Check a site you watch in AI Web on a schedule.
help: Runs one of your AI Web watches. What it looks for and how it reports stay in AI Web; the routine decides when it runs and keeps its history.
